title: The Crossroads of Fate
next_chapter_hook: The news Su Qingyao brought left Chen Ji deep in contemplation — the Fate Scribe was not the only one; the fourth force hidden in the shadows was quietly weaving a new chess game.

text.content: Deep within the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, Chen Ji sat cross-legged, golden light flowing around him like rivers and seas surging forward. The complete Tianji Record floated three inches before his brow center, each page burning with the flames of fate — this was the ultimate transformation he had exchanged for sixteen years of restraint, calculation, and scheming. Yet, as the final thread of information infused into his Mental Sea, he felt a bone-deep chill.

It was neither technique nor divine ability, but a multiple-choice question. Three paths, three outcomes, each leading to vastly different shores. The first path — the Liberator, severing the chains of fate, transcending beyond the heavenly chessboard, with the cost of abandoning everyone you care about; the second path — the Chess Player, becoming the new chess master, commanding the world's chess game, with the cost of being forever trapped in scheming and losing all genuine hearts; the third path — the Sacrifice, using oneself as offering, utterly destroying the Eye of Heavenly Way, with the cost of your existence being erased from the world.

dialogue.content: Choose, Chen Ji. Mo Xiansheng's aged voice came from deep within the Tianji Record, carrying a compassion never seen before. I have witnessed countless people walk these three paths, their fates dissolving into the dust of history. Will you... be the exception?

text.content: Just then, Chen Ji felt a strange fluctuation in his Mental Sea. It was a consciousness connected to him by blood yet utterly different — Chen Ling, his twin of fate, the sister taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Her consciousness appeared independently for the first time, no longer a vague sensing, but a clear, temperature-bearing existence.

dialogue.content: Brother... Chen Ling's voice was like bells hanging in the wind, clear yet carrying undeniable weakness. I felt it... the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Way. It's waiting for your choice, it's threatening you with my existence. Don't... don't choose the path of sacrifice for me.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his knuckles gently tapping on the meditation cushion, each tap like striking fate's death knell. He remembered the rainy night sixteen years ago when his master handed him the Tianji Record Fragment and said — This object cannot be wielded by ordinary people; only those with great fortune, great wisdom, and great ruthlessness can glimpse its true meaning. Sixteen years had passed; he walked the world with a废物人设, hiding all scheming beneath humble smiles. Now, he had finally arrived at the crossroads of fate.

dialogue.content: A gender-transcending majestic voice seeped from the depths of the Tianji Record — that was the Eye of Heavenly Way, the final antagonist, not a specific person but a transcending consciousness. Chen Ji, you have disappointed me. Its tone carried condescending scrutiny. Do you think obtaining the complete Tianji Record can change anything? I let you see these three paths merely to see... which foolish manner of death you would choose.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a derisive curve forming at the corner of his mouth. This expression he had practiced for sixteen years, used every time against those fellow disciples who mocked him, every time against those elders who looked down on him. But now, this derision was aimed at heaven. Disappointed? His voice was calm as water. I would like to ask the Eye of Heavenly Way — when you let me see these three paths, did you truly give me a choice, or was it predestined that I could only walk the one you designed?

choice.prompt: Faced with the Eye of Heavenly Way's arrogant scrutiny, Chen Ji chose...

choices.description: To question the nature of the Eye of Heavenly Way on the spot, exposing that it was merely a puppet fearing loss of control, and forcefully severing its surveillance over fate using the power of the Tianji Record. Extremely high risk, but could forge a completely new path.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 50 points of Heavenly Fate Value, withstand Heavenly Way's backlash
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the title Against Heaven, the Eye of Heavenly Way temporarily loses track of you
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Way will immediately descend with judgment, potentially implicating everyone present

text.content: Chen Ji rose abruptly, the Tianji Record erupting in his palm with dazzling light. He stepped forward, his voice cutting through the void like a sword blade: Who do you think you are? The torrent of information flowing from the Tianji Record instantly formed a barrier, isolating the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Way. I, Chen Ji, have calculated without miss for sixteen years, not to listen to your tricks here!

choices.description: Sheathe the blade, continue deceiving the Eye of Heavenly Way with the废物人设, secretly seek the possibility of a third path. Utilize the Tianji Record's foresight ability to weave your own chess game in the cracks.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily suppress the rage, consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate Value for deep foresight
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence: the Eye of Heavenly Way is not invincible, there exists a fatal weakness
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Way may see through your disguise, the situation will become more passive

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his eyes, sheathing all sharpness beneath the shell of cowardice. He slightly bowed, his voice soft as a mosquito's whine: What the Heavenly Way says is correct... I... this humble one understands. However, in the instant he lowered his head, the Tianji Record had already captured that crack — the Eye of Heavenly Way's gaze was not impenetrable; it was afraid of something.

choices.text: To consider the path of sacrifice
choices.description: To protect Chen Ling and everyone he cared about, Chen Ji began seriously contemplating the possibility of sacrificing himself. But the rebellious discontent and the instinct to scheme within his heart rebelled furiously.
choices.visible_cost: Enduring tremendous psychological torment, Heavenly Fate Value passively depleting
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling's consciousness strengthened, establishing a deeper connection with you
choices.risk_hint: Once truly stepping onto the path of sacrifice, there will be no turning back

dialogue.content: Chen Ling's voice suddenly became clear and firm: "Brother, don't! I don't want you to die for me! Sixteen years... I've waited sixteen years, not to watch you disappear again!" Her consciousness burst through the blockade of the Tianji Record, creating a brief resonance with Chen Ji's divine sense—a bloodline-connected, inseparable bond.

text.content: At this moment, the doors of the Tianji Hall were violently pushed open. Su Qingyao's figure appeared within the light, her garments stained with blood, her face pale, yet her eyes burning with unprecedented determination. Her arrival shattered the deadlock and brought new variables.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly with anxiety, "The Fate Scribes... I've found them!" She stumbled forward, kneeling on one knee, yet still staring intently at Chen Ji, "They're not one person, but an organization! And... they said there's a Fourth Path!"

text.content: The Fourth Path. These four words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The pressure of the Heavenly Eye suddenly faltered, as if that transcendent existence felt a moment of surprise. And in that instant, Chen Ji caught a glimpse of the fissure in fate—the thing he had endured sixteen years to wait for was never any of the three predetermined paths, but this Fourth Path that had never been written into the Heavenly Secrets!

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao brought crucial intelligence, Chen Ji chose...

choices.text: To inquire about the Fourth Path
choices.description: Let Su Qingyao detail the intelligence held by the Fate Scribes, searching for that path never written into the Heavenly Secrets. This requires trusting Su Qingyao, and may expose more trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the existence of the complete Tianji Record to Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Obtained crucial clues to the Fourth Path, opening a brand new chess game
choices.risk_hint: Can Su Qingyao be absolutely trusted? Is her intelligence source reliable?

text.content: Chen Ji reached out to support Su Qingyao; those eyes that always concealed calculations were now calm as still water: "Qingyao, tell me slowly." His address changed unconsciously, the intimacy he hadn't spoken in sixteen years spilling out in the hour of danger. Su Qingyao startled slightly, then pulled a blood-stained Jade Slip from her bosom: "This... is the token of the Fate Scribes. They said the Fourth Path is called 'The Transcender'—neither fleeing nor playing chess, nor sacrificing, but... ascending dimensions."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶带来的命运书写者情报

choices.text: Verify the authenticity of the intelligence
choices.description: Trust no one easily, use the Tianji Record to foresee the truth behind Su Qingyao's words. May get lost in the vast information, or discover hidden conspiracies.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate Value for deep foresight
choices.visible_reward: Discovered three key details hidden in Su Qingyao's words
choices.risk_hint: The foresight process may be detected by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond immediately, but closed his eyes to enter a state of deep foresight. The Tianji Record operated frantically within his Mental Sea, breaking down every word, every expression, every breath from Su Qingyao into variables of fate. Three breaths later, he opened his eyes, cold light flickering in his pupils: "What you said is true. But you concealed one thing—the person who gave you that intelligence... is already dead."

The pressure of the Heavenly Eye suddenly shifted, as if that transcendent existence sensed something. Chen Ji felt an inexplicable chill seep from the depths of the Tianji Record—that was Heaven's fear, its rage, its attempt to prevent the emergence of the Fourth Path. And just then, Chen Ling's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of joy: "Brother... I can feel it! The key to the Fourth Path lies between us!"

The resonance of the twin fates produced a strange chemical reaction. Chen Ji felt his consciousness intertwining with Chen Ling's in an unprecedented way; the text on the Tianji Record began to change wildly, the glyphs representing the three paths gradually blurring, replaced by a brand new light that had never appeared in any prophecy.

choice.prompt: The embryo of the Fourth Path emerged, Chen Ji decided...

choices.text: To achieve complete resonance with Chen Ling
choices.description: Completely release the divine sense, fully merge consciousness with Chen Ling, wager everything to touch that road no one has ever walked. Success means transcendence, failure means eternal perdition.
choices.visible_cost: The existence of Chen Ling might thus vanish
choices.visible_reward: Open the path of the 'Transcender,' obtaining the ultimate power to oppose the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: An irreversible choice, the price of failure is double annihilation

dialogue.content: 'Brother……' Chen Ling's voice became incomparably clear within the resonance, 'This time, let's go together.' The two consciousnesses intertwined in an instant into a brilliant light, all the text on the Tianji Record burning, reorganizing, and transcending. The Heavenly Eye's roar rushed forward like a tide, yet was mercilessly blocked outside by this light.

choices.description: After perceiving the risk, proactively cut off the resonance, preserving Chen Ling's independence. This path, though conservative, at least won't let her be buried with him. The cost is losing this opportunity, requiring a longer time to scheme.
choices.visible_cost: Missed the optimal window period, need to seek the opportunity anew
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling's consciousness remains completely intact, gaining the 'Twin' passive skill
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will take the opportunity to counterattack, time is running out

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully retracted his spiritual sense, forcibly cutting off the resonance at the most critical moment. The tearing sensation made him groan, but seeing Chen Ling's still intact existence in his Mental Sea, he felt a complex emotion intertwined with relief and bitterness. 'Silly girl,' he murmured, 'I searched for you for sixteen years, not to lose you again.' Chen Ling's consciousness trembled slightly, yet responded with a smile: 'Brother…… you're still so self-righteous.'

The atmosphere in the Tianji Hall froze to its extreme limit. The Heavenly Eye's pressure bore down on everyone like a physical force. Su Qingyao's face grew paler and paler, yet she still stared fixedly at Chen Ji, waiting for his decision. And at this moment, a familiar figure stepped out from the Void—it was Ling Yuan, the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, and his arrival made the situation even more complex.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, you have greatly disappointed me.' Ling Yuan's voice was aged yet imposing, his eyes flickering with complex light. 'You think obtaining the complete Tianji Record can change anything? Sixteen years ago I was abandoned by this thing, and sixteen years later you're nothing but the next sacrifice.' His gaze swept over Su Qingyao, over the flickering crossroads of fate. 'Now, I give you a choice—submit to me, or…… die.'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose, tidying his slightly disheveled robes. His gaze toward Ling Yuan was terrifyingly calm, that was the first time the fangs suppressed for sixteen years truly revealed their cold gleam. 'Old Sect Master,' his voice drifted lightly, 'you say the Tianji Record abandoned you, but have you ever considered…… perhaps it wasn't that it abandoned you, but that you made a wrong choice at some crucial moment?' The Tianji Record burst open in his palm, countless runes spinning like a galaxy. 'Since you're here, then…… let's settle all accounts together.'

Su Qingyao struggled to stand, blocking in front of Chen Ji, her sword light cold and sharp as frost. Her voice, though weak, was exceptionally firm: 'Ling Yuan, you think I don't know your plans? You want to reshape yourself using the Heavenly Eye's power, yet you don't realize you're merely another chess piece!' She turned to look at Chen Ji, her eyes full of urgency and concern. 'Chen Ji, no matter which path you choose…… I'll walk it with you to the very end.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao softly said: 'Chen Ji, I found them. They're not a single person, but an organization! And…… they say there's a fourth path!' Her voice trembled slightly from exhaustion, but her eyes burned with the light of hope.

text.content: The three paths of fate slowly unfolded before Chen Ji, the Heavenly Eye, Ling Yuan, Su Qingyao, Chen Ling…… everyone was waiting for his answer. Sixteen years of restraint, scheming, and arrangement, countless humiliations of playing the pig to eat the tiger, all converged in this moment into a tumultuous flood. Chen Ji took a deep breath, the Tianji Record blazed fiercely in his palm, the fourth path no one had ever walked was waiting at the crossroads of fate—for him, and for everyone.
